question: A 6-week-old infant attends the PHC for the first time. According to India's Universal Immunisation Programme (UIP) schedule, which vaccines should be administered at this visit?

answers.text: OPV, Pentavalent, Rotavirus, IPV, PCV, and Hepatitis B

tipsAndFeedback.chosenFeedback: Correct. At 6 weeks, UIP recommends OPV dose 1, Pentavalent dose 1, Rotavirus dose 1, IPV dose 1, PCV dose 1, and Hepatitis B dose 2.
BCG, OPV zero dose, and first Hepatitis B dose are given at birth. The 6-week schedule includes additional vaccines.
MMR is not given at 6 weeks — it is scheduled at 9–12 months. The 6-week visit includes OPV, Pentavalent, Rotavirus, IPV, PCV, and Hepatitis B.
DPT and OPV boosters are scheduled at 16–24 months. Typhoid is given at 9–12 months in the UIP schedule.

overallFeedback.feedback: At 6 weeks, UIP requires OPV dose 1, Pentavalent dose 1, Rotavirus dose 1, IPV dose 1, PCV dose 1, and Hepatitis B dose 2.
Well done! The 6-week UIP visit includes OPV, Pentavalent, Rotavirus, IPV, PCV, and Hepatitis B vaccines.
